title: Identification of prognostic signatures in remnant gastric cancer through an interpretable risk model based on machine learning: a multicenter cohort study.
summary: Two hospitals contributed 286 patients, with five-year follow-up; train/validation/test analyses and variable interpretation are reported. An interpretable machine-learning risk model predicts survival in remnant gastric cancer using a multicenter cohort. Testing: Retrospective multicenter cohort; risk estimates are not causal and external validation is still needed..
